notes.summary: Handwritten continuation about a presumed Boolean algebra of supports, a qualification in a long diagonal note, and a cosupport definition from the ordered set plus compatibility. The final example concerns connected components.
notes.math_reading_decisions: The paired wedge/vee pattern prompted close reading of each small sign; no sign was corrected from an expected distributive law. Comparing only this page’s tuple and set relation helped distinguish the locally plainer R and curled relation. No theorem was proved or formally checked.
notes.author_checks: The author writes “Je [dis cancelled] présume”, cancels “Il faudra y revenir”, and raises a proof difficulty for the three-support formula. My transcription retains the uncertain “je ne vois comment prouver” wording without supplying pas.
notes.title_dates_pagination: Manuscript number 68 at top centre; scan marker 69 retained. No title or date. No cote marker added. H editorial descriptions are treated as commentary, not literal manuscript text.
